_comment: macro_master.json - configuration for the six-engine macro pipeline. Every block is optional; engines degrade to sane defaults when a block is absent. Credentials are NEVER stored here - the API key is read from the environment / _restored/.env.

economic._comment: New opt-in knobs. Defaults reproduce the baseline scorer. Set regime_model='hmm' + model_weight>0 to use the sticky-HMM posterior; use_surprise/use_delevel blend change vs trend; event_trim scales gross down near known events; use_nlp reads context['headlines']/'rbi_text'.

_comment: FALLBACK macro block. STATIC values, used only when no live provider
supplies a signal. They do NOT auto-update, so they drift silently -
which is how 'currency' sat at 84.5 while USD/INR was near 95.9.
LIVE now (fetched every 6h, provenance shown on the dashboard):
currency       FBIL reference rate via RBI
gdp_growth     MoSPI NAS, real GDP YoY computed from constant prices
employment     MoSPI PLFS unemployment rate, person, rural+urban
The values here are only the last-resort fallback for those four.
STILL STATIC (no scriptable source found - see notes per key):
climate, tax - no citable source exists, so their weights were set
to 0. Scoring an invented number is worse than scoring nothing.

gdp_growth.src: MoSPI NAS real GDP YoY, Q1 FY27 computed from constant-price levels (LIVE via MospiProvider)

bond_return.src: FBIL/CCIL 10Y G-Sec benchmark yield. NOT live: FBIL+CCIL render via JS, NSE allIndices exposes index LEVELS only (NIFTY GS 10YR = 2644, which is ~2644 not a yield), FRED unreachable. Do not substitute the index for the yield.

debt.src: RBI/IMF general government debt/GDP. Annual release; SOTW (IMF WEO) gives 83.4 for 2026 but its API silently ignores the country filter, so it is not wired.

employment.src: MoSPI PLFS unemployment rate, All-India, person, rural+urban, all ages (LIVE via MospiProvider)

inflation.src: MoSPI CPI All-India Combined (LIVE via MospiProvider). Rural is 5.23 and Urban 4.31 - the Combined row is the headline.

climate.src: UNSOURCED placeholder. Weight is 0 - not scored. No free citable series exists for this input.

tax.src: UNSOURCED placeholder. Weight is 0 - not scored. No citable series; note the only candidate (GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS) measures tax REVENUE, not the effective corporate rate, and ends FY2022.

currency.src: FBIL reference rate via RBI (LIVE via RbiReferenceRateProvider)

forex_reserves.src: RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement. NOT live: data.rbi.org.in refuses scripted access (SAP token needs a browser fingerprint) and the WSS HTML pages carry only a 3.4KB JS template. Weekly release, so a dated value is defensible.

signals._fii_inflow_comment: FII net cash from the vendor parquet. Kept at 0.5 because the Market engine already scores FII in risk_appetite; this adds it to the macro composite without double-counting the full weight. Stale flow is capped at multiplier 1.0 by the Economic engine.

market._fii_zscore_comment: 20-day mean/std z-score of FII net flow, blended with the level score. One day of flow is noisy: +2000 Cr is unremarkable in a week running +/-4000 Cr but extreme in a quiet month.
market._fii_scale_comment: Cr of FII net flow that scores +/-1. 6000 = ~95th pct of |daily FII net cash| over 170 vendor trading days, so normal days stay mid-band. Was 1000, which saturated the score on 82% of days and made a -1305 Cr day indistinguishable from -5000 Cr.

portfolio._comment: portfolio_inputs below is the LAST-RESORT fallback. The live path is provider_ref -> providers/factory.py:portfolio_inputs, which assembles openalgo (history/positionbook) + account (funds) + price_cache + this static block. Set BLUE_PORTFOLIO_CONFIG=/path/to.json to override the universe/costs per deployment without editing this file. P0 finding (11y walk-forward, net of India costs): no optimiser beat inverse_vol SIGNIFICANTLY (all Sharpe CIs spanned zero), so optimiser choice is stability-driven; the COST lever is ~20x larger than the optimiser lever. Hence rebalance_band_pct=1.0 (cost 268 -> 171 bps for ~0.02 Sharpe).

costs._comment: Conservative India DELIVERY cost model, bps of notional per side. Override for intraday/F&O (STT differs).

sector._comment: Optional Mansfield relative-strength stage. Supply aligned benchmark and sector close series in sector_market_data. Agent is opt-in; any invalid or unavailable advice applies zero-allocation WAIT_AND_SEE limits.

agent._comment: Optional frontline advisory. Backend chain: Ollama (local, unlimited, no key) -> OpenRouter free-tier overflow -> disabled. Only explicit public text from context.agent_inputs is sent. Suggestions NEVER write configuration or place orders, and for veto-capable keys the agent may only move in the safe direction (see _CAPS in core/frontline_agent.py).

memory._comment: Three memories for the stage skills. JSON only, under <agent_io.sandbox>/_memory/: working.json (this shift + last few cycles), calibration.json (what each station usually produces and how often the rails clamp it), mistakes.json (the exact failure each station made, capped and de-duplicated). Memory enters the prompt as CONTEXT: it never sets an operative number, never clears a veto and never bypasses the validator. Delete a file to forget that memory; it degrades to empty, never to an error.

self_correction._comment: Automatic self-correction loop. After each skill answer a DETERMINISTIC judge (schema validator + data gate) decides whether to re-ask. max_attempts is hard-clamped 1..3; every attempt shares the ONE session call budget above, so a loop cannot drain the free tier. 'tools' enables the read-only data toolbelt (core/data_tools.py) so the agent can fetch missing evidence instead of guessing. A clamped answer is a SUCCESS and is not retried.

tools._comment: Read-only evidence the agent may fetch for itself. read_roots are directories whose *.json payloads may be read (capped at 512 KB each). Nothing here can write.

agent._agentic_comment: max_rounds/max_calls bound the optional read-only tool loop. Hard-clamped to 4 rounds / 6 calls in AgenticLLM so a misconfiguration cannot drain the OpenRouter free tier (50 req/day below 10 credits, 1000 above).

llm._chain_comment: Order is fixed in code: ollama, then openrouter, then disabled. Set enabled=false to drop a backend from the chain.

ollama._comment: OLLAMA_HOST defaults to http://127.0.0.1:11434. Fill 'digest' (e.g. sha256:...) once the model is pinned: ':latest' is mutable, so an upgrade would silently change agent output.

openrouter._comment: Overflow only. ':free' variants are capped at 20 req/min and 50 req/day (< 10 credits) or 1000 req/day (>= 10 credits). A 429 marks the backend exhausted for the rest of the UTC day.

agent_io._comment: Where an agentic stage skill may publish its answer. JSON ONLY: core/skill_writer.py refuses any other extension, any path outside this sandbox, NaN/Infinity, and every protected config basename (macro_master.json, strategy.active.json). An agent can never write code or configuration.
agent_io._sandbox_comment: Empty = <repo>/data/agent_stage. Every accepted AND refused write is appended to <sandbox>/_audit/writes.jsonl.

stage_gate._comment: DATA SUFFICIENCY gate, evaluated by deterministic code only (core/stage_gate.py) - never by an LLM. 'halt_analysis' stops the analytic chain at the first stage whose evidence is missing; risk/infrastructure/POV-block still run so the report is complete. 'warn' records the verdict and continues. Per-stage requirements may be overridden in 'stages'; a stage listing [] is left ungated.

screener._comment: Optional pipeline stage. Runs when enabled: the candidate universe is the screener.in sectors selected by the sector HM gate. Network scraping stays bounded by the polite limits below. PAPER-RUN FIRST - this is a strategy change, not just a switch.
screener._sector_filter_comment: When enabled, the stock universe is chosen by the sector HM gate (RSI > EMA) instead of a hard-coded 'sectors' list. The gate and the index->screener slug map are documented in docs/My_trading_system_SOP/SOP.md section 8b. Measured out-of-sample: RSI>EMA scored 0.518 (5d) / 0.535 (20d) against 0.500 for random; adding an RSI<=40 cap REDUCED it to 0.454 / 0.446, so require_discount is false on purpose. An explicit 'sectors' list always wins over this filter.

valuation._comment: Optional, offline pipeline stage. Requires caller-supplied company financial snapshots.
